headline: EU Council President Proposes €1.78 Trillion Budget and 3% Digital Tax
summary: European Council President António Costa presented a revised €1.78 trillion draft budget for 2028–2034, cutting overall spending by 10 percent while allocating €45 billion for farmers and introducing a 3 percent digital services tax.
why: The Multiannual Financial Framework sets long-term spending limits across European Union member states for agriculture, regional development, and defense. Proposed EU-wide taxes directly affect multinational tech platforms.

impacts.name: European Union
impacts.why: Budget negotiations outline long-term fiscal distribution across all 27 member nations.
